name: Niederbachem
method: unweighted mean over the reporting rain gauges of this gauge's rain FIELD, which is: every gauge assigned to it or to any gauge upstream of it (via basin/orphan, the hydrological part), plus every rain gauge within 15 km of the gauge itself (via local), and where that yields fewer than 3 the 3 nearest instead (via knn). Thiessen with equal areas over that field — a rain field around the gauge, not areal precipitation over its catchment and not a catchment intersection
align: rain day d = [d 07:00, d+1 07:00) MEZ; overlaps level day d 17 h, d+1 7 h
